data: Which of the following plots show the blue line crossing the orange line?

The question asks which plot shows the blue line crossing the orange line. The blue line represents the Position metric, while the orange line represents the Standard metric. 

From the analysis of the two graphs:

1. In the first graph (Exact Match), the blue line (Position) is consistently below the orange line (Standard). There is no crossing point visible.

2. In the second graph (F1 Accuracy), the blue line (Position) crosses the orange line (Standard) at approximately the 0.4 mark on the x-axis.

Therefore, the second graph (F1 Accuracy) shows the blue line crossing the orange line.
